notes.title: Dora: Rainforest Rescue | Announce Trailer
notes.content: [p]🎒 Grab your backpack, 🗺️ find your map, and 📣 tell your kids. Dora: Rainforest Rescue is coming to consoles and PC on October 24th 🎮 🌳! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="km2tzTlCCvM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]✨ Your child will go on an interactive adventure with their amigos, Dora and Boots, playing in solo or local co-op mode. [/p][p]✨ Watch your kid laugh, dance and complete challenges with Ale, Tico, Isa, Benny, and Big Red Chicken. [/p][p]✨ They will discover secret paths in the rainforest to unlock new areas and skills, collect items and earn crystals.  Want to find out more about the game? ¡Vámonos! Let’s go!
